description: Suijin OS v7.2.0 — The Impact Release. Depth over volume, proof that stays provable, and a sealed box to run it all in. `suijin box` builds a resumable, resource-capped Kali environment (orbstack first, docker fallback, overridable) with one-way host→box config sync and drift-aware enter; every tool declares its platforms, prereqs and ordered fallback install chains instead of discovering them by failure; the reference-adoption batch lands URL hygiene, fresh CSRF extraction, out-of-band SSRF evidence, tool_search with a catalog budget, tool fallback chains, platform-control framing, repeat-nudges, and a tamper-evident PoC store re-verified at report time; the doctrine states the environment contract explicitly; and the silent max_iterations 100 ceiling is gone — infinite is the product default.
